title: IELTS Mock Test 2026 January Writing Practise Test 2
rules: Stay in full-screen mode until you submit the exam.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.heading: Writing Task 1
tasks.summary: Complete Task 1 in at least 150 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The chart below shows the percentage of children in a European country who took part in four kinds of activities in 2009.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.heading: Writing Task 2
tasks.summary: Complete Task 2 in at least 250 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. In many places large shopping malls are replacing small shops. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development?
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 250 words.
